questions.text: What is the order of calls between parts when the seat booking functionality runs?

questions.text: Which modules or types own the seat booking functionality and how are they arranged?

limitations: Grain is restricted to the component unit level.

rationale: The evidence successfully supports component identification and ownership for seat booking and can carry a PlantUML representation, though dynamic call ordering requires partial inference due to limited sequence details.
